description: List which episodes of a long-running anime are filler, recap or mixed (part story, part original) so they can be skipped. Covers a small reviewed set of series and says so when a series is not covered. Episode numbers only, no plot details. Give a title or a catalog ID.

mal_id.description: The catalog ID from a title search (the same number MyAnimeList uses). Use it instead of a title when you have it.

title.description: The show's name, in English or romaji, for example "Attack on Titan".
